title: Grilled Lemon-Mint Turkey Shawarma Kebobs
ingredients: 4 tsp shwarma seasoning (has about 1 tsp salt)
instructions: Prep & mise en place: Gather and prepare all components for Grilled Lemon-Mint Turkey Shawarma Kebobs.
BBQ on hot grill max heat one side,  50% heat on using side around 11 minutes rotating every 2 mins
Season to taste with kosher salt, freshly cracked black pepper, and finishing garnishes before serving warm.
notes: Original Doc Shorthand: 1 lb turkey — 1 small onion — 4 tsp shwarma seasoning (has about 1 tsp salt) — 2 tsp parsley — 2 tsp garlic powder — Juice of one lemon — 1 tsp chopped mint — 1 finely diced chili — BBQ on hot grill max heat one side,  50% heat on using side around 11 minutes rotating every 2 mins
